title: 2023 Mosaic Marvin Mims Reactive Yellow #346 Gem MT PSA 10
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Mosaic Marvin Mims Reactive Yellow #346 Gem MT PSA 10 trading card is a must-have for any Denver Broncos fan or collector. Featuring the talented rookie wide receiver, this card is sure to be a valuable addition to your collection. 

With its vibrant yellow design and rare parallel variety, this card is a standout piece for any sports trading card enthusiast. Manufactured by Panini and approved by PSA, this card is of the highest quality and is a great investment for any collector looking to add to their collection.
